Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Ingredients: For the shells: 10.5 oz (300 g) canned or cooked sweet corn, drained 3.5 oz (100 g) shredded cheese For the filling: Cream cheese Ham Tomato Fresh herbs How to make them: Spread the corn into circles on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with shredded cheese. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes, until golden and crispy. Let them cool slightly, then carefully remove from the parchment. Fill with cream cheese, ham, tomato and fresh herbs. Fold in half and enjoy! ✨ Crispy, cheesy, easy and SO satisfying! Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 Creamy, spicy, sweet, and crispy all on one plate. The perfect blend of heat, honey, and that rich, silky pasta sauce. Recipe: Chicken + Marinade: • Chicken tenders • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Morton’s Season-All • 1 tsp cayenne pepper • 1 tsp Kinder’s All Purpose • 1 tsp Tony’s seasoning • 1 packet Sazón • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp parsley • 1 cup buttermilk • 2 tbsp jalapeño juice Flour Coating: • All-purpose flour • Same 1 tsp seasonings as above Hot Honey Sauce: • ½ cup Frank’s Buffalo • ¼ cup honey • 1 tbsp hot sauce (adjust to taste) Pasta + Sauce: • 1 box penne pasta • 1 tbsp chicken bouillon powder (for boiling pasta) • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • Minced garlic • Chopped onion • 1 tbsp flour • 1½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp of the same seasonings listed above • 4 oz mozzarella cheese • Extra 1 oz mozzarella for finishing ⸻ Instructions: 	1.	Season chicken with all spices listed for the marinade, pour in buttermilk and jalapeño juice, and mix well. Let marinate for 30 minutes. 	2.	Season flour with the same spices. Coat chicken in the flour, shaking off excess. 	3.	Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken for 7–12 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside. 	4.	In a small pot, simmer Frank’s Buffalo, honey, and hot sauce until glossy, then toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 	5.	Boil penne pasta in water seasoned with chicken bouillon powder until tender, then drain. 	6.	In a pan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic and chopped onion until fragrant. Add flour and whisk for 30 seconds. 	7.	Slowly pour in heavy cream, add the same seasonings, and let it thicken. Stir in 4 oz mozzarella until smooth. 	8.	Add pasta into the sauce along with the additional 1 oz mozzarella and mix until creamy. 	9.	Plate pasta, top with hot honey chicken, and drizzle extra sauce for that perfect sweet-heat finish. #fyp #hothoney #hothoneychicken #pasta #blackpeoplerecipes

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Share this with the person you want to drive this road with! Having only seen this online.. finally seeing it in person absolutely blew my mind🤯 📍This is Going to the Sun Road in Glacier National Park, Montana. 🚗 It’s the only road that crosses Glacier National Park east to west, taking you from lush forest to alpine tundra in under 50 miles. 🌄The road climbs up to 6,646 feet at Logan Pass, with epic views of glacier-carved valleys, alpine lakes, waterfalls, and wildflower meadows. You also have a huge opportunity to see a variety of animals. We saw 2 bears, several mountain goats, bighorn sheep and deer. 🎟 If you are arriving in season between 7:00 am - 3:00 pm you will need a timed entry pass that you can secure online. However, if you arrive before 7 or after 3 you are free to just go! I highly recommend arriving earlier for sunrise - or even doing it for sunset.  ⏰If you don’t plan on stopping, the drive will take about 2 hours from the west entrance to the east entrance, but I highly recommend getting out along the way to explore. pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Ingredients The chicken 2 lb chicken breast or thigh, cut into bite size pieces ⅓ cup greek yogurt  2 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 ½ tsp turmeric  2 tsp garlic grated  2 tsp ginger grated 1 tsp fenugreek leaves 1 Tbsp olive oil The juice of 1 lemon 1 tsp salt The sauce 3 Tbsp ghee 4 cardamom pods 4 cloves 1 piece of cinnamon stick 4 cloves garlic, sliced 1 inch knob ginger, sliced 1 green chile, minced 24 oz crushed tomatoes ⅓ raw cashews  1 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 cup cream 1 tsp fenugreek leaves Salt to taste To start in a bowl add the yogurt, kashmiri chile powder, garam masala, turmeric, garlic, ginger, fenugreek leaves, olive oil, lemon and salt. Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

In the same pan, add a small piece of butter and fry the onion, garlic, and spices together for 5 minutes over low heat until softened. Then add the tomato passata, sugar, and heavy cream. Serve it with white rice and naan bread.   👀 Remember that seasonings are always to taste, so don’t be afraid to add more if needed. Quickly dip the pasta tubes into the cold coffee for 1–2 seconds. 6. Pipe the cream into both ends of each tube. 7. Dust with cocoa powder or grated chocolate and chill for 20–30 minutes before serving. #EasyDessert #CoffeeDessert #HomemadeTreat #CreamCheese #DessertLover

🧑🏽‍🍳 livthepositivefooodie🧑🏽‍🍳  My oven baked chicken recipe with some red pesto thrown into the mix! Served with rice this time instead of spaghetti BUT this would be unreaaaaaaal with some pasta 😮‍💨 My fave thing about this recipe is it’s literally a case of throwing it ALL into an oven dish and letting it cook! That’s it!! Plus the Parmesan sprinkled on top makes it go really crispy and it’s beaut 🥵 Ingredients to serve two: 2 large chicken breasts 2 handful cherry tomatoes 60g reduced fat soft cheese / single cream 2tbsp red pesto 10g Parmesan 200mls chicken stock cube 1tsp paprika, mixed Italian herbs, garlic, salt and pepper To serve: basmati rice and broccoli Method: Preheat your oven to 200, then add your chicken to an oven dish with some oil followed by the cherry tomatoes. Season your chicken with the paprika, mixed Italian herbs, salt and pepper. In a jug, make up the chicken stock and then add in the soft cheese (or cream) and stir until the cheese dissolves. Pour this into the oven dish. Add the pesto in, putting some on the chicken itself and some into the sauce and giving it a stir. Pop this into the oven for 25-30 mins. Make sure tour chicken breast is cooked through and piping hot before serving. Macros (without rice) 390 calories 48g protein 20g fat 2.3g carbs #Foodie  #Foodrecipes #MealIdeas #Chefsoftiktok #FoodSpots #RecipesofTikTok #Cooking #YummyFood #ShareRecipes

Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

FAA Says Airport Only Had One Controller At Time Of Collision #usa #america  The FAA says the helicopter and plane collided because there weren’t enough Air Traffic Controllers. Reagan National was operating with one controller who had to manage all air traffic in the area & that tower typically has at least two controllers for the level of traffic the area was under at the time. So the controller who was handling helicopters was also handling landings and departures of planes. This comes after Trump froze the hiring of Air Traffic Controllers and offered them buy outs to leave their jobs earlier this week. He also reportedly fired hundreds of critical staff & allowed Elon to seemingly push the head of the FAA out. Just this past summer, the FAA released a report that it needed 3,000 more air traffic controllers nationally. This morning Trump blamed DEI DEI DEI. But Trump is doubling down on this lie with him now signing a Presidential memorandum ordering competence over DEI. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Aguantaste críticas, derrotas, comparaciones y golpes que habrían hecho bajar los brazos a cualquiera. Pero vos seguiste. Porque había un sueño que era más grande que todo: ganar algo con la Selección. Y un día rompiste esa pared. Nos enseñaste que rendirse nunca es una opción, que los sueños se persiguen hasta el final y que el esfuerzo siempre encuentra su recompensa. Jamás nos dejaste solos. Jamás abandonaste este escudo. Y por eso te voy a admirar toda la vida. No llores, capitán. El fútbol ya te hizo eterno. Ya no le debés absolutamente nada a este deporte. Fuiste el pibe que soñó y terminó inspirando a millones de argentinos. Y si las despedidas siempre duelen, esta duele un poco más. Porque no solo termina un Mundial; también se cierra una de las etapas más lindas de nuestra historia. Gracias por cada alegría, por cada abrazo, por cada lágrima y por hacernos creer cuando parecía imposible. Gracias por todo, Leo. Looks can be deceiving, much like how this meal looks like it took you hours to prepare! 😉 This Parmesan Ranch Chicken is as easy as one, two, three! Serve it over rice or pasta for a complete meal that your family will devour. Continue reading or click the link in the @allrecipes bio to get the full recipe! 🔗 Ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken cutlets 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/2 cup plain yogurt 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons ranch seasoning mix 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 green onions, thinly sliced Directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). If using whole chicken breasts, cut them in half lengthwise to form 6 chicken cutlets. Arrange chicken in a single layer in the bottom of a lightly greased  baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, yogurt, Parmesan, ranch seasoning, salt, and pepper until well combined.  Spread mayonnaise mixture over in a thick layer evenly over the chicken and bake about 17 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Without removing the chicken from the oven, turn the oven temperature to Broil and cook until browned and bubbly on top, another 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes; sprinkle with green onions before serving. 🧑‍🍳: Nicole #parmesanchicken #chickendinner #chicken #dinner #dinneridea

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Cinnamon rolls… made in 20 minutes, and every bite is the center of the cinnamon Roll In depth recipe with pictures on substack!!! 🛒 Ingredients Dough 1 cup (130g) all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp cinnamon 1/3 cup (80ml) milk (or half milk, half heavy cream) 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp melted butter Coating 1 tbsp melted butter 3 tbsp sugar 1-2 tsp cinnamon Vanilla Bean Glaze ✨ 4 tbsp powdered sugar 2 tsp heavy cream 1/2 tsp vanilla Vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan 2️⃣ In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon 3️⃣ Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter 4️⃣ Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix 5️⃣ Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites 6️⃣ Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar 7️⃣ Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking 8️⃣ Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake 9️⃣ While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed 🔟 Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy ⏱ Time & Servings Prep 10 min Cook 10 min Serves 2 to 3 🔥 Pro Tip Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Honey chipotle chicken wraps ✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken - 1lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed - 1lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed - 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt  - 1/4 cup chipotle adobo sauce  - 1 tbsp garlic paste - 1 tbsp avocado oil or any neutral oil of choice - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 2 tsp oregano  - 2 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp chili powder - 1 tsp adobo - 1 tsp cumin - 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste - 3 tbsp honey  Chipotle lime mayo - 1/2 cup mayonnaise - 2 tbsp chipotle adobo sauce  - Juice of 1/2 lime - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt and pepper to taste  For serving - Large flour tortillas  - Diced red onions - Dice sweet peppers - Shredder lettuce  - Cilantro  Instructions  - In a large bowl of cubed chicken add oil,  yogurt, adobo sauce, garlic paste, spices, salt, and pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Cover bowl and marinate for 1 hour minimum or overnight for best results. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and slightly charred on the edges. Make sure to cook in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan. - After chicken is fully cooked add honey and toss chicken until even coated. - In a small bowl, mix all chipotle lime mayo ingredients until smooth. Taste and adjust salt/lime if needed. - Heat tortillas on a dry pan or microwave for 30 seconds. - Add chicken, shredded lettuce, red onion, sweet peppers, and cilantro. Drizzle generously with chipotle lime mayo. Fold and toast in a greased skillet for 1-2 minutes until slightly golden brown. - Serve and enjoy! • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenwraps #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe

It’s time to get your ranunculus pre-sprouted for spring! Ranunculus are a gorgeous spring flower, but a big mistake that is often made is that they’re started too late! Ranunculus actually LIKE cool weather and they need a long, cool growing period if you want to get those gorgeous, big, abundant flowers!  One of the biggest mistakes I see people doing is starting these flowers way too late… and the common instructions actually encourage this mistake because they often say to “start after your last frost”… but if you do this, you won’t get many flowers and they won’t be that good. Why? Ranunculus go dormant once temps consistently reach 80 degrees F, so if you wait until your last frost date to start… well by the time they’re blooming, most climates are already reaching those temperatures. So the secret to healthy, beautiful plants is: don’t start them too late!! Like other cool flowers, the long growing period in cool weather helps establish a strong root system that will spring into loads of flowers once the temperatures start warming up. Ranunculus can easily handle temperatures of 26 degrees F for several hours, AND they take an app. 90 days to get to flowers so you really want to be presprouting these at the latest 6 weeks before your last frost, but 8-10 weeks is a much better time frame!  Presprouting is simple: Soak your corms for 4-6 hours and then lay them in a row with the ‘tentacles’ down in trays with potting soil. Cover with another thin layer of soil and keep them in a 60-65 degree space until you see a few leaves on each plant. It generally takes 2 weeks. Once you see leaves, transplant them into your beds app. 6 inches apart. You can either set up low tunnels over them (you’ll get longer stems), or just leave them in the open air… but make sure you cover with a frost cloth if your temperatures drop below 26 degrees. Save this for reference when you plant and let me know if you have questions: I’m happy to answer them! . . . . #ranunculus #springflowers #urbanfarming #flowers #gardenlove #cottagecore #gardening #gardensofinstagram #growyourown #cutflowers #flowerfarmer

In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. EASY MEALS FOR 2 EP. 14  ONE PAN DUMPLING LASAGNA BEFORE YOU COOK !! PLS READ * a lid for your pan is essential ! If you dont use a lid the pork won't steam / cook properly * the water + chicken boullion is importing, it not only adds flavour but allows the bottom to cook without burning ! ( the dumpling wrapper will kind of boil at first, but then you can remove the lid, let the water mixture evaporate and let the bottom crisp up )  Ingredients Pork Filling * 350 g ground pork * 2 green onions, finely chopped (about 42 g) * 100g Chinese leek, finely chopped * 1 tsp Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base * ¼ cup (60 mL) water Seasonings * 3 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tsp grated ginger * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp sesame oil Assembly * 1–2 tbsp neutral oil * Dumpling wrappers (I used about 1 pack)  Steaming Liquid * ¼ cup (60 mL) water * ½ tsp Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base Chili Sauce * 1 tbsp soy sauce * 2 tbsp chili oil * ½ tsp sesame seeds Garnish * Chopped green onions Instructions 1. Make the Filling In a large bowl, combine: * Ground pork * Green onions * Chinese leek * Soy sauce * Oyster sauce * Ginger * Salt * Black pepper * Sesame oil Dissolve 1 teaspoon Better Than Bouillon in ¼ cup water, then pour it into the pork mixture. Mix everything vigorously for 2–3 minutes until the filling becomes sticky and the liquid is fully absorbed. 2. Assemble Add 1–2 tablespoons neutral oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, layer the dumpling wrapper and filling like show. In the video.  3. Steam Mix together: * ¼ cup water * ½ teaspoon Better Than Bouillon Chicken Base Pour this mixture evenly throughout and around the edges of the pan. Cover with a lid. Cook over medium heat for about 8 minutes, or until the pork is fully cooked and the wrappers are tender. 4. Crisp the Bottom Remove the lid. Continue cooking for another 2–4 minutes, allowing any remaining liquid to evaporate and the bottom wrappers to become crisp. 5. Make the Sauce While the dumpling lasagna cooks, combine: * 1 tbsp soy sauce * 2 tbsp chili oil * ½ tsp sesame seeds 6. Serve Drizzle the chili sauce over the dumpling lasagna. Finish with plenty of chopped green onions and serve immediately. #creatorsearchinsights #dumplings #lasagna #DinnerIdeas #cooking

Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

Recipe Name Shrimp & Sausage Stuffed Cabbage Ingredients 1. 1 large green cabbage 2. 1 lb (450 g) shrimp, peeled and deveined 3. 12 oz (340 g) smoked sausage, sliced 4. 1 medium onion, diced 5. 1 bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 tbsp butter 8. 2 tbsp olive oil 9. 1 tsp paprika 10. 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 11. 1/2 tsp black pepper 12. 1/2 tsp salt 13. 2 tbsp chopped parsley 14. 1 tsp lemon juice Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Cut the cabbage into thick wedges, keeping the core intact. 3. Roast the cabbage wedges for 15 minutes until slightly tender. 4. Heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic until fragrant. 6. Add sliced sausage and cook until browned. 7. Stir in the shrimp, paprika, Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper, cooking just until the shrimp turn pink. 8. Spoon the shrimp and sausage mixture over each roasted cabbage wedge. 9. Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes to blend the flavors. 10. Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley before serving hot. Follow our account for more delicious recipes you'll love to make.

Save this for an easy weeknight meal you’ll keep coming back to 🌯💛 RECIPE⬇️ Creamy Chicken Mushroom Wraps Servings: 4 wraps Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Ingredients: For the Chicken: * 2 chicken breasts, diced * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp salt For the Mushroom Mixture: * 1 tbsp butter * 1 cup mushrooms, sliced * ½ medium onion, finely chopped For the Secret Sauce: * ¼ cup mayonnaise * 2+ tbsp creamy pasta sauce * 1 tsp sriracha (adjust to taste) Additional Ingredients: * 1 cup spinach, chopped * ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped * ½ cup shredded cheese (mozzarella, cheddar, or a blend) * 4 large tortillas Instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and season. Cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. 2. In the different pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions, and sauté for about 5 minutes, or until softened and golden brown. 3. Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and combined. 5. Place a tortilla flat on a clean surface. Spoon a generous amount of the chicken and mushroom filling into the center. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Place each wrap seam-side down in the pan and toast for 1–2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy. #nourished #nourished #homecooking #chickenwrap #mushroomchicken #easydinner #simpledinneridea #yummyeats #proteindinner #CapCut

Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

They are fooling you to get your 💵  Every collagen cream, serum, and moisturizer on the market? A waste of your money.  Collagen is a protein molecule too large to penetrate the skin barrier, it just sits on top and does nothing. The only way collagen actually works is from the inside out. Here’s what the science says: A double-blind trial (2025) found just 2.5g/day of collagen peptides reduced wrinkles and improved elasticity in 4 weeks. A meta-analysis of 26 clinical trials confirmed it works, but only after 8+ weeks of consistent use. And a 2024 RCT found 12 weeks of daily collagen caused a 44% decrease in collagen breakdown, 22% more elasticity, 13% more hydration, AND a 27% increase in hair growth. The catch? It has to be hydrolyzed collagen peptides. Not the stuff in your moisturizer. Save this. dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. 😮‍💨 263 Cal Chicken Caesar Salad Chalupas 📍 My high protein chalupa series has been super viral and I think I might’ve the best one yet! ✅ Macros for each Chalupa: 263 Cals, 15g Carbs, 8g Fat, 36g Protein ✅ Macros (32g) Caesar Dressing: 29 Cals, 0.5g Carbs, 1.75g Fat, 3g Protein ✳️ 29 Cal Caesar Dressing:  227g Plain Non Fat Greek yogurt Juice from ½ Fresh Lemon 14g Olive Oil 30g Worcestershire sauce 10g Dijon Mustard 24g Grated parmesan cheese 3 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon Kosher salt Water to desired consistency ✳️ Caesar Salad: 300g Romaine 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for Chicken Caesar Dip: 16oz Chicken Breast 1 ½ tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 1 tsp Salt ½ tsp Black Pepper ½ tsp Paprika ½ tsp Dried Parsley 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for 1 Chalupa: 1 Josephs Pita 4g Parmesan 12g Part Skim Mozzarella 1/4th Batch of Chicken Caesar Dip Cooking Spray (added 1g fat to macro per chalupa) ❇️ Directions: 1️⃣ Take your chicken breast and pat dry with a paper towel. Then flatten. I just use my fist lol. 2️⃣ Then season both sides with seasoning mix recipe above. Air fry on 400 degrees F for 9-10 minutes. 3️⃣ While that’s cooking, make your caesar dressing by adding all your ingredients into a bowl and mixing. 4️⃣ Now chop up your chicken breast once done and add to a bowl. Combine with the buffalo caesar dressing 1/6th caesar dressing. 5️⃣ Chop up 300g romaine and add 1/6th caesar dressing to it. Can add more but we don’t want the romaine to be soggy. 6️⃣ Now put together your chalupas. Lay one pita down then add to on side 6g mozzarella, 2g parmesan, 1/4th of your chicken caesar dip, 2g parmesan, 6g mozzarella. 7️⃣ Fold your chalupa tightly. Spray both sides with cooking spray and add to air fryer on 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. I added some ramekins on top of each one to make sure they stayed closed while in the air fryer. 8️⃣ Once done, open them up, add your caesar salad and enjoy! #caesarsalad #chalupa #airfryer #highproteinmeals#mealprep

videos.caption: Recipe Name Caramel Cream Rice Krispie Treats Ingredients 1. 6 cups crispy rice cereal 2. 4 cups mini marshmallows 3. 4 tbsp unsalted butter 4. 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter 5. 1/2 cup caramel sauce 6. 1 cup white chocolate chips 7. 4 oz cream cheese, softened 8. 1/2 cup powdered sugar 9. 1 tsp vanilla extract 10. 1 cup heavy whipping cream 11. 1/4 cup caramel sauce, for drizzling 12. 1/2 cup crispy rice cereal, for topping Recipe 1. Line a 9×13-inch baking dish with parchment paper and lightly grease it. 2. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over low heat. 3. Add the mini marshmallows and stir continuously until completely melted and smooth. 4. Stir in the peanut butter until fully incorporated. 5. Remove the mixture from the heat and gently fold in the crispy rice cereal. 6. Press half of the cereal mixture firmly into the prepared dish to create an even base. 7. Melt the white chocolate chips gently in the microwave in short intervals, stirring between each interval. 8. Beat the softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth. 9. Whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture. 10. Spread the cream mixture evenly over the first cereal layer. 11. Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to help the creamy layer firm up. 12. Gently press the remaining cereal mixture over the cream layer without crushing it. 13. Warm the caramel sauce slightly and drizzle it generously over the top. 14. Sprinkle additional crispy rice cereal over the caramel. 15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm enough to slice. 16. Lift the dessert from the pan using the parchment paper and cut into neat squares. 17. Drizzle each piece with extra caramel before serving for an extra rich finish. Follow this account for more irresistible no-fuss desserts and recipes you will want to make again.

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

🧀 bbq cheddar glazed chicken breasts ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon smoked paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1/2 cup favorite bbq sauce 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded salt and black pepper to taste instructions: step 1: prep the chicken pat chicken breasts dry. mix paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. rub the spice blend thoroughly over the chicken. step 2: sear heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat. sear the chicken for 5–7 minutes per side until deeply browned and nearly cooked through. step 3: glaze brush the bbq sauce generously over each chicken breast. step 4: melt top each piece with a handful of sharp cheddar cheese as seen in image_de7a84.jpg. cover the pan with a lid for 2–3 minutes, or place under a broiler, until the cheese is melted and bubbling. step 5: serve remove from the pan and let rest for 5 minutes before serving hot. perfect tips: for a stickier glaze, let the bbq sauce caramelize in the pan for an extra minute before adding the cheese. healthy tips: use a sugar-free bbq sauce and serve alongside a fresh garden salad instead of heavy sides. gluten-free tips: verify that your bbq sauce and all dry spices are certified gluten-free. prep time: 10 minutes | cook time: 15 minutes | total time: 25 minutes | servings: 2 #bbqchicken #cheddarbrushedchicken #smokybbq #easydinner

Honey Sesame Chicken Ingredients: For the Chicken: 1 chicken breast, cubed ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp nutritional yeast ½ tsp baking powder 1 egg 2 tbsp cold water 1 tbsp avocado oil 2 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp flour (I used gluten-free) For the Sauce: ½ tbsp avocado oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp honey 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp ketchup ½ tbsp rice vinegar ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil 1 tbsp sesame seeds ¼ cup water + 1 cornstarch, mixed Green onions, chopped, for topping Directions: For the Chicken: In a bowl, combine the chicken, salt, black pepper, nutritional yeast, and baking powder In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, water, avocado oil, cornstarch, and flour Pour the egg mixture over the chicken and let sit for 10-15 minutes Heat 2-3 inches of oil to 350 F, then fry the chicken pieces until at least 165 F at the thickest part Remove the chicken from the oil, then place on a paper towel to absorb excess oil For the Sauce: In a bowl, combine the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sesame seeds In a wok or high-sided pan on medium-low heat, warm the oil, then cook the garlic until fragrant, around 1-2 minutes Add in the sauce mixture and the cornstarch and water mixture, then mix until thickened Remove from the heat and add in the chicken pieces; mix and serve topped with green onions Enjoy!! #sesamechicken #chinesefood #trendingfoods #viralrecipes
